subject: Procurement: PO metadata, invoice rhythm, and net‑term options to finalize pricing
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@nexxahealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nexxahealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PO metadata & invoice rhythm we need to close pricing

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team is excited. Procurement asked me to gather a definitive list of the PO fields Nexxa needs on invoices, the acceptable invoice cadence (monthly vs. milestone), and which net terms you can support for a new enterprise commitment.

Two quick constraints from our side:
- Our AP team requires a PO reference on every invoice (PO number + line item IDs when present).
- We operate on net45 as a standard; to meet internal approval we need either net45 or a documented preauthorization/commitment to allow net30.

Can you confirm: 1) exact PO header fields you require, 2) whether you can accept split invoices for monthly consumption under a single PO, and 3) how discounting (volume/annual) interacts with net term exceptions?

If helpful, I can push a sample PO from our side. We’d like to finalize commercial terms this week so legal can send the signature packet.

Best,
Maya
Procurement Lead, Nexxa Health
procurement@nexxahealth.com

---
Note: attaching our internal PO template if useful; happy to loop in AP lead for details.

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@nexxahealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, procurement@nexxahealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO metadata & invoice rhythm we need to close pricing

Maya — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up front, then a consolidated option set below.

Short answers:
- Required invoice headers: vendor name, Redwood Inference (legal entity), invoice date, invoice number, PO number (exact match to your PO header), billing entity (if multi-entity), line item code / SKU when present, tax id, remit-to address, and our GL code (we accept a custom field).
- Split invoices: yes — we can accept monthly invoices that reference the same master PO. We’ll ask that each invoice includes a PO-line reference and a small ledger tag to support your ERP matching (we’ve attached our Invoice Field Guide).
- Net terms and discount interaction: core pricing is applied on committed annual spend. We can be flexible on net terms tied to pre-authorized credit or an early-pay concession. See Option A/B below.

Attachments: NEXXA_PO_Template_v2.pdf, Redwood_Invoice_Field_Guide.xlsx, Redwood-SLA-and-Commitments.pdf

Option A — Standard (preferred for operational simplicity)
- Net terms: net30
- Invoice cadence: monthly, consumption-based. Each invoice references master PO + monthly ledger tag.
- Discount: Annual commit tiers (see attached quote); discounts applied on monthly invoices as line-level credit.
- Preauth: none required.

Option B — Procurement flexibility (to accommodate net45)
- Net terms: net45 allowed if Nexxa provides a preauthorized deposit/credit equal to one month of run-rate at contract start (applied as a credit memo across first invoices).
- Invoice cadence: monthly or milestone (milestone invoices need explicit mapping to PO line IDs).
- Discount: same annual commit tiers, but effective discount may be staged until preauth is reconciled. If Nexxa prefers not to prepay, we can offer a 0.75% administrative fee to cover extended receivable risk.

If neither option maps cleanly to your AP policy, we can offer a hybrid: net45 on month-to-month invoices for the first 3 months while preauth is established, then move to net30.

Next steps: I’ll loop internally to confirm whether legal needs special invoicing language for split invoices. If you can share a sample PO, we’ll validate field parity against the attached template.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

Subject: internal: Nexxa netterms & discount structure — recommendation

Markus / Karthik — quick internal note so we can finalize Mark's external reply. I reviewed the Nexxa ask and their typical net45 stance. Thoughts: give them a clear path that protects cash and keeps discounts predictable. Proposed structure below.

Proposal (internal):
- If Nexxa signs an annual committed contract >= $360k ARR equivalent, offer Tier 2 discount (7% effective) and accept net45 with no preauth, provided Nexxa supplies an AP contact and automatic PO renewal cadence. This keeps sales momentum and preserves cash via commitment.
- For smaller commitments (< $360k), require Option B preauth equal to one month of projected run-rate or offer net30 with a 0.5% early-pay discount if they pay within 10 days.
- Operational asks: require PO number on invoice, and two custom fields: "PO-Line" and "ERP-LedgerTag" so their ERP can automatically match. We should surface an FAQ section in onboarding about split invoices and how credits are applied.

Cost impact (approx):
- Accepting net45 without preauth on Tier 2: working capital hit = ~1.5% of annual revenue (projected) — manageable if deal hits forecast.
- Early-pay 0.5% discount: small incentive cost but reduces days-sales-outstanding materially.

Recommend we present both options to Nexxa and indicate we can finalize legal language in the MSA (DocuSign link). I suggest we also provide an AP contact for a short call with their procurement team to align field names.

-Vanessa
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations

Subject: Final: PO fields and two pricing/net‑term options for Nexxa (please confirm)

Maya — following internal review, thanks for the patience. Below are the firmed-up options so your legal/AP can pick the path that works best.

Required invoice headers (must be present exactly as fields):
- Vendor name (Redwood Inference, Inc.)
- Redwood tax ID: 94-3335551
- Invoice number
- Invoice date
- PO number (must match master PO exactly)
- Billing entity (if multiple)
- PO-Line (custom field)
- ERP-LedgerTag (custom field)
- Remit-to address: Redwood Inference, AP Dept, PO Box 12345, San Francisco, CA

Option 1 — Operational preferred
- Net terms: net30
- Invoice cadence: monthly, consumption invoices referencing master PO + PO-Line
- Discounting: annual commitment discounts applied as monthly line credits; example tiers in HubSpot quote (link above).
- Attachments: NEXXA_PO_Template_v2.pdf, Redwood_Invoice_Field_Guide.xlsx

Option 2 — Procurement flexibility (allows net45 without prepayment)
- Net terms: net45 (no preauth) if contract >= $360k ARR commit or equivalent annual spend.
- Invoice cadence: monthly or milestone (if milestone, each invoice must map to PO-Line entries).
- Discounting: same tiered discounts, but discounts become unconditional only after first-quarter reconciliation.
- If contract < $360k, net45 requires a preauthorized credit equal to one month of projected run-rate, applied as a credit memo to initial invoices.

Operational items we request from Nexxa AP:
- A sample PO (we’ll validate parity).
- AP contact for a 20-minute field-alignment call (to agree on exact ERP-LedgerTag formatting).
- If you need, we can provide a short onboarding FAQ that explains how split invoices and credits are represented in our invoices.

If you can confirm which option you prefer I’ll have legal issue the signature packet and we’ll attach standard invoicing language.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
